title: Local information of ADC quadratic lattices over algebraic number fields
summary: In the paper, we mainly determine the structures, counting formulas, and density sets of representations for binary and ternary ADC quadratic lattices over arbitrary non-archimedean local fields. In the binary case, we show that under certain conditions, there are finitely many primitive positive definite ADC lattices and infinitely many non-primitive ones. We also provide concise formulas for local densities and masses using invariants from BONGs theory, and show that these invariants completely determine the local densities over arbitrary non-archimedean local fields.
